title: 051 Scarecrow I
description: Part of the 051 Scarecrow Series — a triptych exploring the archetype of the scarecrow as a symbol of isolation, protection, and presence.

title: 051 Scarecrow II
description: The centrepiece of the 051 Scarecrow Series. The figure stands at the intersection of the natural and the constructed.

title: 051 Scarecrow III
description: The final piece in the 051 Scarecrow Series. A quiet conclusion — the figure recedes, leaving only its shadow.

title: Cashmere
description: A study in softness rendered through the stark contrast of graphite and charcoal. Texture evoked through light and shadow.

title: Matelassé
description: Inspired by the quilted, raised texture of matelassé fabric. How a two-dimensional medium can suggest depth, weight, and tactility.

title: Oyster with Two Pearls
description: An intimate still-life. The duality of the two pearls speaks to the nature of twins, pairs, and things that mirror each other without being identical.

title: Galactic Slayer
description: A cosmic warrior rendered in bold digital strokes. The piece draws on science-fiction iconography and reimagines the hero at the edge of the galaxy.

title: Untitled
description: Some things resist naming. This piece lives in that space — deliberate in form, open in meaning.

title: Daystar Reboot
description: The sun — rebooted. A meditation on cycles, renewal, and the violence and beauty of beginnings.

title: Lighthouse
description: A beacon in the dark. The lighthouse stands not just as navigation but as a metaphor for clarity, guidance, and solitary illumination.

title: Mom's Request
description: Made at the request of the artist's mother. A tender piece, personal in its origin and universal in its warmth.

title: Inception
description: The moment of beginning — of an idea, a world, or a self. The hazy boundary between thought and reality.
